description: checkHealth at shell/index.ts:107-118 uses a dynamic import of './store.js' inside the function body, despite the module already being imported at the top of the file (line 3 imports getOAuthStore/getLinkSessionStore from './store.js'). The dynamic import will always succeed because Node.js caches modules. This means checkHealth can never return { status: 'error' } in the current implementation - the error path is unreachable. When PostgreSQL is integrated, this function must be completely rewritten, and the dead error path gives false confidence that failure detection works.
